trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (failing health checks, 18% error rate) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with healthy production status.
- Verified post-rollback: all regions are now running v2.3.0, service is **healthy**, error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), documenting the failure of v2.3.1 and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, so it may be worth investigating the root cause before any redeploy attempt.
